provenance.note: Procedural vertex-coloured mend ward post (W46-18, activities.gd _build_ward): a keeper's lamp post on a stepped slate plinth with an iron strap and copper rivets, iron column, verdigris mend collar, copper patch plate, hand wheel, hung spanner and a verdigris lamp head, 0.9 x 2.39 x 0.9 m. One mesh, one draw, watertight.
